hypothesis: Replaying wrong complete training decisions may reduce greedy cycles while preserving protected relation generalization on each fixed graph.
graph_suite: Reuse the matching prepared data and checkpoint; do not generate a new split.
selection: Initialization is eligible; choose lowest validation Huber plus existing complete-candidate soft-rank CE. Evaluate test and all routes after freezing selection; no automatic expansion or adoption.
split: Reuse the original membership, pairs and complete stars. Mine wrong first actions exclusively from train_tasks; reject any parent/candidate-to-goal label with nonzero membership. No held-out queries, trajectories or failures enter replay.
scope: Two independent256-node maps, each with control/replay from its own adopted Q and Adam. New matched seeded sampling streams, not exact historical resume. Same512 point pairs and256 complete decisions/update, architecture, losses, physical neighbors and greedy budget. Replay changes half the decision sampling only; ordinary random draws remain matched. Four4000-update runs then stop; adopted maps and FLAN training maps unchanged.
